description: This file manages media storage, including saving, resolving, cleaning old media, and handling media files securely within a media directory. It includes functions for downloading media, sanitizing filenames, and ensuring safe file operations.

classes.name: SaveMediaSourceError
classes.description: Custom error class for media source saving errors with specific error codes.

methods.name: extractOriginalFilename
methods.description: Extracts the original filename from a path if it matches the embedded pattern.

methods.name: ensureMediaDir
methods.description: Ensures the media directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: cleanOldMedia
methods.description: Removes media files older than a specified TTL, optionally recursively and pruning empty directories.

methods.name: saveMediaSource
methods.description: Saves media from a URL or local path into the media directory, performing mime detection and filename sanitization.

methods.name: saveMediaBuffer
methods.description: Saves a media buffer directly into the media directory with optional content type and filename.

methods.name: resolveMediaBufferPath
methods.description: Resolves a media ID to its absolute file path, ensuring safety against traversal, symlinks, and invalid files.

methods.name: deleteMediaBuffer
methods.description: Deletes a media file by its media ID, ensuring safe path resolution.
